claims.statement: Rival commission in the Council Hall (Battle of Cascina). Both artists were in Florence at the same time, which is documented. The bar shows this overlap, not a recorded friendship. Direct exchange between them is mostly reported by later writers.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Commission records; later sources.
